18:             return "Method Not Allowed";

20:             return "Payload Too Large";

26:

31: std::string HttpResponse::serialize() const {
32:     std::string data;
33: 
34:     data += "HTTP/1.1 ";
35:     data += std::to_string(static_cast<int>(status));
36:     data += " ";
37:     data += reason_phrase(status);
38:     data += "\r\n";
39: 
40:     bool has_content_length = false;
41:     bool has_connection = false;
42: 
43:     for (const auto& [name, values] : headers) {
44:         if (header_name_equals(name, "Content-Length")) {
45:             has_content_length = true;
46:         }
47:         if (header_name_equals(name, "Connection")) {
48:             has_connection = true;
49:         }
50: 
51:         for (const auto& value : values) {
52:             data += name;
53:             data += ": ";
54:             data += value;
55:             data += "\r\n";
56:         }
57:     }
58: 
59:     if (!has_content_length) {
60:         data += "Content-Length: ";
61:         data += std::to_string(body.size());
62:         data += "\r\n";
63:     }
64: 
65:     if (!has_connection) {
66:         data += "Connection: close\r\n";
67:     }
68: 
69:     data += "\r\n";
70:     data += body;
71: 
72:     return data;
73: }

42: Result<int> Server::create_server() {
43:     // AF_INET : use ipv4
44:     // SOCK_STREAM : use tcp
45:     // 0 : Allow System Choose Agreement by itself
46:     int fd = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);

64:     sockaddr_in address{};

66:     address.sin_family = AF_INET;
67:     // listen all network card
68:     address.sin_addr.s_addr = INADDR_ANY;
69:     // change byte order(Big-Endian -> Little-Endian)
70:     address.sin_port = htons(config.port);

74:                sizeof(address)) < 0) {

190: std::string Logger::to_html(const LogQuery& query) const {
191:     std::string html = read_root_file("log_template.html");
192:     std::string contents;
193:     std::string status_message;
194:     std::size_t line_count = 0;
195:     std::size_t scanned_files = 0;
196:     std::size_t scanned_lines = 0;
197: 
198:     if (!valid_log_date(query.date)) {
199:         status_message = "Invalid log date.";
200:     } else {
201:         auto files = log_files(std::filesystem::path(this->base_path) / query.date);
202:         scanned_files = files.size();
203:         if (files.empty()) {
204:             status_message = "No log files found.";
205:         } else {
206:             for (const auto& [index, path] : files) {
207:                 std::ifstream file{path};
208:                 if (!file) {
209:                     continue;
210:                 }
211: 
212:                 std::string line;
213:                 while (std::getline(file, line)) {
214:                     ++scanned_lines;
215:                     if (!line_matches_level(line, query.level) ||
216:                         !line_matches_keyword(line, query.keyword)) {
217:                         continue;
218:                     }
219:                     contents += html_escape(line);
220:                     contents.push_back('\n');
221:                     ++line_count;
222:                 }
223:             }
224:             status_message = line_count == 0 ? "No matching log lines." : "Logs loaded.";
225:         }
226:     }
227: 
228:     std::string escaped_date = html_escape(query.date);
229:     std::string escaped_level{view_level_name(query.level)};
230:     std::string escaped_keyword = html_escape(query.keyword);
231:     std::string escaped_status_message = html_escape(status_message);
232:     std::string line_count_text = std::to_string(line_count);
233:     std::string scanned_files_text = std::to_string(scanned_files);
234:     std::string scanned_lines_text = std::to_string(scanned_lines);
235:     std::string all_selected = selected_attr(query.level, LogViewLevel::All);
236:     std::string debug_selected = selected_attr(query.level, LogViewLevel::Debug);
237:     std::string info_selected = selected_attr(query.level, LogViewLevel::Info);
238:     std::string warn_selected = selected_attr(query.level, LogViewLevel::Warn);
239:     std::string error_selected = selected_attr(query.level, LogViewLevel::Error);
240: 
241:     using Replacement = std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>;
242: 
243:     const std::array replacements{
244:         Replacement{"{{log.date}}", escaped_date},
245:         Replacement{"{{log.level}}", escaped_level},
246:         Replacement{"{{log.keyword}}", escaped_keyword},
247:         Replacement{"{{log.line_count}}", line_count_text},
248:         Replacement{"{{log.scanned_files}}", scanned_files_text},
249:         Replacement{"{{log.scanned_lines}}", scanned_lines_text},
250:         Replacement{"{{log.contents}}", contents},
251:         Replacement{"{{log.status_message}}", escaped_status_message},
252:         Replacement{"{{log.level.all_selected}}", all_selected},
253:         Replacement{"{{log.level.debug_selected}}", debug_selected},
254:         Replacement{"{{log.level.info_selected}}", info_selected},
255:         Replacement{"{{log.level.warn_selected}}", warn_selected},
256:         Replacement{"{{log.level.error_selected}}", error_selected}
257:     };
258: 
259:     return render_template(html, replacements);
260: }

262: void Logger::run() {
263:     while (true) {
264:         std::queue<LogEntry> local_queue;
265: 
266:         {
267:             std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->mutex);
268:             this->condition.wait(lock, [this] { return this->stop || !this->queue.empty(); });
269: 
270:             if (this->stop && this->queue.empty()) {
271:                 return;
272:             }
273: 
274:             local_queue.swap(this->queue);
275:         }
276: 
277:         while (!local_queue.empty()) {
278:             const auto& entry = local_queue.front();
279:             auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
280:             std::string date = Logger::date_string(now);
281:             this->rotate_if_needed(date);
282: 
283:             if (this->output.is_open()) {
284:                 this->output << Logger::timestamp_string(now) << " ["
285:                              << Logger::level_name(entry.level) << "]: " << entry.message << '\n';
286:                 ++this->current_line_count;
287:             }
288:             local_queue.pop();
289:         }
290: 
291:         this->output.flush();
292:     }
293: }

295: void Logger::rotate_if_needed(const std::string& date) {
296:     if (this->current_date != date) {
297:         if (this->output.is_open()) {
298:             this->output.close();
299:         }
300: 
301:         this->current_date = date;
302:         this->current_file_index = 0;
303:         this->current_line_count = 0;
304:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
305:         return;
306:     }
307: 
308:     if (!this->output.is_open()) {
309:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
310:         return;
311:     }
312: 
313:     if (this->current_line_count >= this->max_lines_per_file) {
314:         this->output.close();
315:         ++this->current_file_index;
316:         this->current_line_count = 0;
317:         this->open_output(date, this->current_file_index);
318:     }
319: }

321: void Logger::open_output(const std::string& date, std::size_t file_index) {
322:     namespace fs = std::filesystem;
323: 
324:     std::error_code error;
325:     fs::path date_dir = fs::path(this->base_path) / date;
326:     fs::create_directories(date_dir, error);
327:     if (error) {
328:         return;
329:     }
330: 
331:     fs::path file_path;
332:     std::size_t index = file_index;
333:     while (true) {
334:         file_path = date_dir / (std::to_string(index) + ".log");
335:         error.clear();
336:         if (!fs::exists(file_path, error) || error) {
337:             break;
338:         }
339:         ++index;
340:     }
341: 
342:     this->current_file_index = index;
343:     this->output.open(file_path, std::ios::app);
344: }
